items.title: Why Is United Rentals (URI) Stock Rocketing Higher Today
items.summary: Shares of equipment rental company United Rentals (NYSE:URI) jumped 12.1% in the afternoon session after the company reported second-quarter results that beat Wall Street's top and bottom-line estimates and raised its full-year guidance. Adjusted earnings per share came in at $12.76, topping the consensus estimate of $11.59. Revenue grew 11.8% year-over-year to $4.41 billion, surpassing expectations of $4.20 billion. items.title: S&P 500 Earnings: URI Flashes Buy Signal As Google Hikes Capex
items.summary: S&P 500 member United Rentals soared on stronger-than-forecast Q2 results after Wednesday's close as Google got a late-day haircut.  AI data center construction has helped supercharge earnings for URI, which provides a one-stop shop for large construction projects.  Google's plan to keep boosting capital spending suggests the demand environment for heavy machinery will keep shining, even as it may slow the pay-off for AI hyperscalers.
